title: Lucid Dreaming/Astral Projection?
content: Hey! I originally made this post in another group and they told me to come here! I’m just going to copy and paste the OP below. Hey guys… I’ve been astral projecting for years. Basically I go into a meditative or almost sleep like state and once I’m relaxed I get pin prickles on my body then it’s like a dream except I’m not fully asleep. I walk out my front door and when I step through it I’m in a hotel. Almost like a fairmont. There’s several elevators that go to different rooms and floors (like the glass elevator in Charlie and the Chocolate factory except not glass). There’s a framed photo in the elevator except that I can’t ever make out what it is of. Sometimes I know exactly where I am going and places are easy to get to in the hotel. The rooms in the hotel are ethereal for lack of a better word. They don’t seem to serve a purpose for sleeping. In my favourite room is just a big bathtub the size of a small swimming pool. The walls are 20ish feet high and everything surrounding the pool is white marble - yet I never slip. The walls are floor to ceiling windows and they are made of glass - again though, I can’t make out the image on the other side of the glass - it’s just a warm white light. No one ever bothers me here. Other times, I’ll be stuck on the elevator for full shifts. Unable to move my feet or get out of the elevator. I can interact with other people who get on and off, but they usually just try to give me advice on how to get off the elevator. None of this is why I’m writing though - I am trying to make sense of this one room I go into. Less of a room and more of a world. I enter this room off of the back of a plain Jane room - kind of like a waiting room but the seats are very plush and there’s books everywhere - again, I can’t read them or make out images. Once the door at the backside of the room opens I go in and the vibe of the world is almost like Vegas? It gives me the uncanny valley. The sky is pink and it looks like a carnival setting, but it is a full functioning city. In the middle of the city there is a GIANT dome. Every time I have been there it’s been the venue for a Britney Spears show (I’ve been a big fan since I was a little girl, so not surprising.) The interesting thing is that when there is a show there’s a ton of people around. People line up single file and go into the single door into the dome. I’ve never been in the dome because it feels a little sinister. I can hear the music from outside and some of the lights shine out from the top of the dome (kind of like the Luxor? But a dome). Britney herself I have never seen or heard - only heard her music. When you come out of the show a sideways type garage door opens and hoards and hoards of people come out. Some people look really really excited and thrilled, others are confused, and some are uncontrollably upset and hysterical. People of all kinds line up and go in calm and come out just a bundle of uncontrolled energy for lack of a better term. There’s also a gift shop. It’s a giant tube, again, glass. It’s about 20 feet in diameter and idk how high because I can’t see the end. These people who come out of the show with frazzled energy are like stuck in the gift shop? The only merch in the shop is also easily 50 feet above the ground. The store is dark and filled with sparkly light and it almost glows pink and red. On days when there aren’t shows it’s a ghost town. Only a few people hang around - myself included. I’ve noticed these people are the ones who are calm in the frenzy. That’s kind of just the tip of the iceberg for the hotel. I’ve been exploring around it lots and I’m happy to talk about it if anyone has questions But when I wake up it is always in the hours between 2 and 3 am. Sometimes, I’ll go outside for a smoke to calm down and outside there’s a strange noise. It’s all around me. The best way to describe it is like if someone was playing a wine glass and I was sitting in the bottom of the cup. I’m not sure if it’s alien or what. But I was reading Britney’s book and had to put it down after she spoke of her alien encounter because it rocked me to my core. I haven’t picked up the book since. Is there anyone out there with more knowledge who can help me decipher what the heck is going on?
